name: VIP
displayDescription:

name: Double Coins

When spinning in a crate, you no longer have to wait the few seconds to see your reward. You immediately see your reward.

DISCLAIMER: THIS ONLY WORKS FOR CRATES, NOT THE WHEEL

May need to rejoin to receive effects.
